newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS -- off a touch overall.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS -- off a touch overall.

text.p: U.S. municipal bonds were off a touch overall, as the market paced itself before a busy new issue calendar and testimony from the Federal Reserve Chairman.
"We were off a touch overall. The overall market was unchanged to slighly weaker," a market player said. "High grades were unchnaged to down a bit. And dollar bonds were down a couple of ticks."
Action in the secondary market was light and the primary market saw little activity.
On the economic front, Tuesday marks the start of Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony before the U.S. Congress.
"You always keep your fingers that nothing too dramatically earthshattering comes out of these things," a municipal trader said.
"The market is holding off because of the new issue market and Greenspan. It is pausing wisely before his testimony," another trader said.

New York City's $482 million general obligation bond offering tops this week's new issue calendar. The weekly calendar is expected to total $2.9 billion in 102 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
JP Morgan Securities Inc is expected to price the city GOs Tuesday.

New York City sold a total of $163 million so far in its retail order period. The city sold $45 million of bonds in retail pre-sale on Monday, the second day of the order period. On Friday, the city sold $118 million.
A city official said the retail order period volume is "about normal for us."
Municipal bond sales for Tuesday were expected to total $1.5 billion in 33 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.

Negotiated offerings total $739 million in 10 sales, with the $482 million New York City offering through J.P. Morgan Securities topping the list. To see the full negotiated sales calendar, double click on NEGO1.

On the competitive side, 23 sales totaling $755 million are scheduled. A $217 million Orange County, Fla., offering at 1100 EDT is the largest. To see the full competitive sales calendar, double click on COMP1.
An additional four sales totaling $96 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
For the full note calendar, double click on NOTE1.
In the government market, the benchmark 30-year bond at 1600 EDT was down 6/32 at 101-2/32 to yield 6.54 percent.
In debt futures, the September municipal contract was at 121-7/32. The September T-bond contract was down 5/32 at 114. The MOB spread was 195 ticks..

Reuters said Monday it calculated its 30-day visible supply of upcoming municipal bond sales at $7.410 billion, up $357 million from Friday. Negotiated sales total $4.736 billion in 64 issues and competitive bond sales total $2.674 billion in 130 issues.
